instructions:
1. Set both pulleys to the lowest position and attach a handle to each.
2. Stand in the center, grasp a handle in each hand with palms facing forward, and step forward into a staggered stance.
3. Keep a slight bend in your elbows and your chest up.
4. Pull the handles up and inward until they meet in front of your upper chest.
5. Slowly return your arms to the starting position with control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Lead with your upper chest, not your arms.
2. Keep a fixed slight bend in your elbows the whole set.
3. Exhale as you bring the handles together and inhale as you return.
4. Use a controlled tempo to keep tension on the chest.
name: Cable Upper Chest Crossover

instructions:
1. Attach an EZ bar to the low pulley.
2. Stand facing the machine with feet shoulder-width apart and grasp the bar with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
3. Stand tall with arms extended and the bar resting against your thighs.
4. Pull the bar up toward your chin, leading with your elbows and keeping the bar close to your body.
5. Lower the bar back to the starting position with control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your elbows higher than your wrists throughout.
2. Keep your torso upright and avoid swinging.
3. Exhale as you pull up and inhale as you lower.
4. Stop pulling if you feel pinching in the shoulders.
name: Cable upright row with EZ bar

instructions:
1. Attach a straight bar to the low pulley.
2. Stand facing the machine with feet shoulder-width apart and grasp the bar with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
3. Stand tall with arms extended and the bar resting against your thighs.
4. Pull the bar up toward your chin, leading with your elbows and keeping the bar close to your body.
5. Lower the bar back to the starting position with control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your elbows higher than your wrists throughout.
2. Keep your torso upright and avoid using momentum.
3. Exhale as you pull up and inhale as you lower.
4. A narrower grip emphasizes the traps; widen it to shift to the delts.
name: Cable upright row with straight bar

instructions:
1. Attach a straight bar to the low pulley and place a bench in front of it.
2. Sit on the bench and grasp the bar with an underhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
3. Rest your forearms on your thighs with your wrists just beyond your knees, letting the bar hang.
4. Curl the bar upward by flexing your wrists.
5. Lower the bar back down with control until you feel a stretch.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your forearms flat on your thighs and only move your wrists.
2. Squeeze the forearms at the top of each rep.
3. Use a full range of motion, letting the wrists extend at the bottom.
4. Exhale as you curl up and inhale as you lower.
name: Cable wrist curl

instructions:
1. Set both pulleys to the lowest position and attach a handle to each.
2. Grasp the handles so the cables cross, holding the left handle in your right hand and the right handle in your left.
3. Step back and stand with feet shoulder-width apart, arms extended down in front of you.
4. Raise the handles up and out overhead into a "Y" shape, keeping a slight bend in the elbows.
5. Lower the handles back to the starting position with control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your torso upright and avoid leaning back.
2. Lift with your shoulders, not by shrugging your neck.
3. Use a light weight and controlled tempo for proper form.
4. Exhale as you raise the handles and inhale as you lower.
name: Cable Y raise
